summary: Excellent type-safe TypeScript with solid error handling and clear modular design. Workflow is well-structured with good permissions and triggers. Minor issue: bun install is duplicated across test/report jobs (lines ~15-18 and ~30-33) — should factor into a composite action or shared setup job. Otherwise production-ready: strong validation, deterministic date-pinned testing via act, thorough end-to-end fixtures, and comprehensive error-handling verification.
